definitions.gloss: departure from a country; leaving a country
definitions.explanation: The act of leaving one's country or the country one is currently in, especially passing through official border or immigration controls at an airport or port.

examples.japanese: {出国|しゅっこく}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませた→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
{出国|しゅっこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{提示|ていじ}→提示：12905_teiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: You need to present your passport when leaving the country.

examples.japanese: {出国|しゅっこく}⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できていた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{搭乗|とうじょう}→搭乗：06200_toujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}う→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧だった。
examples.english: There was a long line at the departure immigration, so I worried whether I would make it to boarding.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{出|しゅつ} (go out, exit) + {国|こく} (country). The reading changes to しゅっ before ⟦こく→コク：20672_koku⟧ due to consonant assimilation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
{出国|しゅっこく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb meaning "to leave a country."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出国|しゅっこく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to leave the country)
- {出国|しゅっこく}⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧ (departure immigration check)
- {出国|しゅっこく}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧ (departure procedures)
- {出国|しゅっこく}⟦ゲート→ゲート：10851_geeto⟧ (departure gate)
- {出国|しゅっこく}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (travel ban, exit ban)
